title: Detection of supported cohomology bounds by geometric costalks
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, $S\subseteq|X|$ a subset stable under specialization, $a\in\mathbf Z$, and $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ in the ordinary small etale category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a geometric point $\bar x$ [def-weil-geometric-point] with underlying point $x$, define
$$C_{\bar x}K=R\Gamma_{\{x_0\}}(X_{(\bar x)},K|_{X_{(\bar x)}}),$$
where $X_{(\bar x)}$ is the strict localization with closed point $x_0$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and supported cohomology is the right derived kernel of restriction to the complementary open [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections]; restrictions $K|_{X_{(\bar x)}}$ and $u^*K$ are (exact) inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then the following are equivalent:
(1) $H^m(C_{\bar x}K)=0$ for every $x\in S$, every geometric $\bar x$ over $x$, and every $m\leq a$;
(2) $H^mR\Gamma_Z(V,u^*K)=0$ for every affine etale $u:V\to X$, every closed reduced subscheme $i:Z\hookrightarrow V$ with $u(|Z|)\subseteq S$, and every $m\leq a$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-closed-immersion].
With $u_!$ the exact left adjoint to etale restriction (the sheafified sum over lifts [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]) and $\Lambda_Z$ the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], there is a natural equality of groups
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)}(u_!i_*\Lambda_Z[-m],K)\cong H^mR\Gamma_Z(V,u^*K).$$
These assertions hold without excellence or constructibility.
